name: Tazbentetol
summary: Tazbentetol is a synaptogenic drug which is under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), schizophrenia, diabetic retinopathy, and glaucoma. It is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: The drug targets an undisclosed regulator of the F-actin-based cytoskeleton to increase synaptogenesis. It shows neuroprotective, neurorestorative, and pro-cognitive effects in preclinical research. The pharmacokinetics of tazbentetol have been studied. It has an elimination half-life of 1 to 2 hours in humans.
pharmacology.kind: Synaptogenesis enhancer; Neuroprotective agent; Neurorestorative agent

uses.text: Tazbentetol (INN; developmental code name SPG302) is a synaptogenic drug which is under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), schizophrenia, diabetic retinopathy, and glaucoma.

sideEffects.en: It is still in early trials, so its side effects in people are not well known.
sideEffects.zh: 它仍在早期試驗階段，因此在人體的副作用所知不多。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它仍在早期试验阶段，因此在人体的副作用所知不多。

fact.en: Its code name SPG302 comes from Spinogenix, the company developing it. It is designed to help rebuild synapses, the connections between nerve cells, rather than simply boosting a messenger chemical.
fact.zh: 它的代號SPG302來自研發公司Spinogenix。它的設計目的是幫助重建突觸，也就是神經細胞之間的連結，而不是單純增加某種傳訊物質。
fact.zhHans: 它的代号SPG302来自研发公司Spinogenix。它的设计目的是帮助重建突触，也就是神经细胞之间的链接，而不是单纯增加某种传讯物质。
